name: services/theses/authorship_preference
description: Get information about whether users prefer sharing their theses' authorship.
brief_description: Get information about whether users prefer sharing their theses' authorship.

arguments.name: user_ids
arguments.description:
Pipe-separated list of user IDs. They must be valid user IDs, if
            they're not, then the results are undetermined - you may get an
            error, but you may also get fake/invalid values.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your user_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will be a boolean — true if a person allows to show their authorship for their theses.
